description.value: Immune to death effects; your dying condition can never increase to its maximum value — it always stops one step short.

cinderfall.incomplete: The immunity to death effects and the dying-cap increase (via system.attributes.dying.max, matching the real Diehard feat's exact mechanism) are implemented. 'Stops one step short' is modeled as the same dying.max=5 upgrade Diehard uses -- there is no separate rule-element concept of a dying value that is barred from ever reaching its cap independent of raising the cap itself.
